cs.t: Ikea TROTTEN standing desk (has a hand-crank that I rarely use)  https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/trotten-desk-sit-stand-white-s7...  Jarvis single monitor arm  https://store.hermanmiller.com/office-furniture-desk-accesso...  Apple Studio display  https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/apple-studio-display/stan...  Apple Keyboard (with Touch ID)  https://www.apple.com/shop/product/MK293LL/A/magic-keyboard-...  MX Master 3 mouse  https://www.logitech.com/en-us/products/mice/mx-master-3s.91...  Pixel stand (wireless phone charger)  https://store.google.com/us/product/pixel_stand_2nd_gen  I have one power cable to the monitor and one for the phone charger and a lightning cable from the monitor for charging the keyboard, so I don't have enough cables to "manage". I think I used to plug the phone charger into the monitor but I don't remember why I stopped.
